newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Spot markets quiet, basis weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Spot markets quiet, basis weak.

text.p: Cash soymeal markets were quiet and offers again declined in several areas as domestic and export demand eased, dealers said.

Cash soymeal, basis Chicago and Fostoria, was offered $9.00 per ton over CBOT May, down $3.00 since Friday, and soymeal, basis Lancaster, Pa., was offered $30.00 over CBOT May, down $2.00 since Friday.
One dealer said lush pastures in the southeast U.S. have lessened demand for supplemental feed.
"The pastures look great," said a Midwest dealer. "And after last week's buying, a lot of people got covered."
